verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a platform with SDKs, a CLI, and cloud services, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents any setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The 'telemetry' mentions refer to data tracks that carry application data for robotics and IoT, which is unrelated, and the self-hosting option is only an adjacent workaround, not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
